description: This file defines the Drupal JavaScript API, including behavior management, URL handling, string translation, sanitization, and theming functions. It sets up the global Drupal namespace and encapsulates behavior attachment/detachment logic.

methods.name: Drupal.throwError
methods.description: Helper to rethrow errors asynchronously, allowing errors to bubble up outside the original callstack for easier debugging.

methods.name: Drupal.attachBehaviors
methods.description: Attaches all registered behaviors to a page element, executing their attach functions.

methods.name: Drupal.detachBehaviors
methods.description: Detaches registered behaviors from a page element, executing their detach functions.

methods.name: Drupal.checkPlain
methods.description: Encodes special characters in a string for safe HTML display.

methods.name: Drupal.formatString
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a string with sanitized or themed values based on prefix characters.

methods.name: Drupal.stringReplace
methods.description: Replaces substrings in a string based on key-value pairs, trying longer keys first.

methods.name: Drupal.t
methods.description: Translates strings to the page language, with optional replacements.

methods.name: Drupal.url
methods.description: Constructs a full URL to a Drupal page based on a path.

methods.name: Drupal.url.toAbsolute
methods.description: Converts a URL to an absolute URL.

methods.name: Drupal.url.isLocal
methods.description: Checks if a URL is within Drupal's base path.

methods.name: Drupal.formatPlural
methods.description: Formats a string with correct pluralization based on count.

methods.name: Drupal.encodePath
methods.description: Encodes a Drupal path for URL use, leaving slashes unescaped.

methods.name: Drupal.deprecationError
methods.description: Triggers a deprecation warning if not suppressed.

methods.name: Drupal.deprecatedProperty
methods.description: Wraps an object to warn when a deprecated property is accessed.

methods.name: Drupal.theme
methods.description: Generates themed output by calling a theme function or throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: Drupal.theme.placeholder
methods.description: Formats text as a placeholder with emphasis HTML.

methods.name: Drupal.elementIsVisible
methods.description: Checks if an element is visible in the DOM.

methods.name: Drupal.elementIsHidden
methods.description: Checks if an element is hidden in the DOM.
